Over-representation analysis via gprofiler2

Source: R/keraunos_expression.R
KERAUNOS_ora.Rd

Tests whether a set of genes is enriched for annotated biological terms using gprofiler2::gost(). Supports GO terms, KEGG, Reactome, and other databases available through g:Profiler.

Usage

KERAUNOS_ora(
  genes,
  background = NULL,
  organism = "hsapiens",
  sources = c("GO:BP", "GO:MF", "GO:CC", "KEGG", "REAC"),
  fdr_threshold = 0.05,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

genes

Character vector of gene symbols (or Ensembl IDs, Entrez IDs, etc. — whatever gprofiler2 accepts for the chosen organism).

background

Character vector of background genes, or NULL (default) to use the gprofiler2 reference genome as background.

organism

Character. gprofiler2 organism code. Default "hsapiens". Use "mmusculus" for mouse, etc. See gprofiler2::gost() for full list.

sources

Character vector. Databases to query. Default c("GO:BP", "GO:MF", "GO:CC", "KEGG", "REAC").

fdr_threshold

Numeric. FDR threshold for $significant. Default 0.05.

verbose

Logical. Print a summary. Default TRUE.

Value

A keraunos_ora object (list) with:

  • $results — full gprofiler2 result data.frame (ordered by p-value).

  • $significant — filtered to fdr_threshold.

  • $params — list of parameters used.
